hypothesis_under_test: Current WP800 held-out/independent metadata mechanically prevents a structurally reused development fixture family from being relabeled as a distinct held-out independent evaluation family.

constructive_counterexample.base_fixture: Use any currently valid MicroWorldFixture F, including the repository test fixture.
source_semantics: MicroWorldFixture.__post_init__ validates each fixture internally but has no calibration-vs-heldout registry or relation input.
Changing fixture_id and holdout_set_id changes fixture/public digests, so A and B appear as distinct exact identities even though the underlying task structure is reused.
RunDescriptor.for_fixture accepts independent_reproduction as a caller-supplied boolean and validates its type; no second fixture/split manifest is consulted to derive independence.
MatchedRunPair proves exact same-fixture ancestry for baseline/intervention comparisons; it does not establish that the fixture itself was withheld from development.
constructive_counterexample.why_no_runtime_is_needed_for_this_reprod: The falsifier targets absence of any cross-fixture relation in the exact constructor/RunDescriptor state transition domain. The acceptance path is fully determined by the inspected validators; this receipt deliberately grants no executable/runtime credit.

result.finding: WP800 proves exact object/evaluator integrity, not development-vs-heldout distributional independence. New fixture/holdout identifiers and caller-declared independent_reproduction can coexist with unchanged structural task family.

cross_workpackage_impact: WP802/WP803/WP804/WP806 inherit WP800 fixture integrity but must not call it held-out generalization evidence without a bound split relation.
WP805 currently checks source/target ids/digests/opaque holdout labels but still needs a declared structural split relation for transfer claims.
WP807 aggregate/general-agentic evaluation should consume split-qualified measurements rather than inferring holdout validity from component labels.

recommended_trigger4_regression.test: Construct A/B from one structural fixture family with distinct ids and holdout labels; require heldout-credit admission to fail until a typed SplitManifest/SplitRelation proves the declared IID_INSTANCE or OOD_AXIS disjointness.
recommended_trigger4_regression.minimal_build_shape: central WP800 split provenance object + relation checker + automatic RunDescriptor binding; preserve existing evaluator/public boundary and do not import external benchmark runtimes.

next_exact_action: Trigger4 should consume the E2/E3 handoff under the sole WP800 mutation lane, add the smallest fail-closed split contract/regression, and run repository CI. Trigger6 should not mutate WP800 source directly from this research lane.
